researchPasses.finding: ATUNED canon calls Warrior "moves on the threat" and describes it: "Acts first and reads the damage after.". Jung-derived modern 12-archetype lineup is attributed to Carol S. Pearson and Margaret Mark, not directly a list Jung established.
Trigger: A threat or boundary activates rapid response. Movement: PROTECT → INITIATE → HOLD → REVIEW. Coherent behavior: Proportional defense without retaliation.
Observed law expressions in active SI vocabulary: Courage (Solar); Non-Harm (Root); Accountability (Solar). No law relation here is a new scoring input.
Positive observation: Protects others and accepts review. Contrary observation: Escalates force after danger ends. Do not make fixed moral identities out of archetypes.
